text:
Predicates:
American(x) ::: x is an American national.
ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
CanDoJumpShots(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
LeapStraightIntoTheAir(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
ActivateLegMuscles(x) ::: x activates their leg muscles.
Premises:
∃x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬American(x)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) → CanDoJumpShots(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (CanDoJumpShots(x) → LeapStraightIntoTheAir(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, they leap straight into the air.
∀x (LeapStraightIntoTheAir(x) → ActivateLegMuscles(x)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, they activate their leg muscles.
¬ActivateLegMuscles(yuri) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.
Conclusion:
American(yuri) ::: Yuri is an American national.
